subject.title: feat: add /mark command for session label presets

question: Should preset session marks and their localization policy become a built-in core command and persisted SessionEntry contract, or should this remain an optional plugin capability?
rationale: The patch adds a globally available command, hardcoded preset vocabulary, bilingual response policy, and persisted session state; code review cannot decide whether OpenClaw should permanently own those product choices.

options.title: Route through plugin ownership
options.body: Keep core generic, expose or reuse the minimum session-metadata API required, and implement the preset command as an optional plugin or ClawHub package.

options.title: Sponsor a core command
options.body: Accept `/mark` as a built-in feature after redesigning the data model around explicit mark provenance and defining localization and upgrade behavior.

options.title: Decline the feature
options.body: Retain `/name` as the supported label-editing surface and close the PR without adding another core command or session field.

recommendation.title: Route through plugin ownership
recommendation.body: Keep core generic, expose or reuse the minimum session-metadata API required, and implement the preset command as an optional plugin or ClawHub package.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history most directly connects this person to the built-in command registry where the core-versus-plugin decision lands.
